spec.name: Furniture Garden Lantern
spec.description: A squat garden lantern with a broad stepped iron foot, honey-amber glass, sturdy corner posts and a small rectangular carrying loop. Fits within one block with a generous edge margin; all parts are connected and axis-aligned.

prompt: Create an original vanilla Minecraft furniture model: squat iron garden lantern with amber glass and broad base. Grounded attractive survival-server furniture. Entire model fits x=0..16, y=0..16, z=0..16; floor y=0, front negative Z. 16 units per Minecraft block. Keep a 0.25-unit margin at outer x/z edges.  Use 8-30 purposeful axis-aligned cuboids, no rotations, no bones, no animation. Detailed hand-painted pixel art, coherent palette, explicit non-overlapping cube-net UVs with correct texel density. Connected physical structure, no z fighting, no stand outside the furniture. No text labels, no surrounding scene. Generate the whole piece with its distinctive silhouette and materials.
